articles.title: How this app differs from a tracker
articles.summary: Bodybuilder works out your next meals and lifts for you, and redoes that plan whenever your week shifts. Think of it as a planner, not a food log.

articles.title: Tools you need
articles.summary: Before you start, make sure you have a bathroom scale, access to a gym and a gram food scale. Each of the three sharpens the accuracy of your plan.

articles.title: Weighing in
articles.summary: Weigh in often. Almost every call the app makes comes from your trend weight rather than one reading.

articles.title: Reps in reserve (RIR)
articles.summary: RIR stands for reps in reserve, the number of clean reps you had left at the point you stopped. The target works its way down over the block, so effort climbs toward the last training week.

articles.title: Training on a cut
articles.summary: While you're cutting, your training has one job: protect the muscle and strength you've built as body fat comes down. You get there by keeping the work hard and the progress gradual, with no need to scale back.
